note: Per-cell, per-transition-polarity propagation-delay FLOOR for every combinational cell in sky130_fd_sc_hd that has both a cell_rise and a cell_fall table, at two of the corners spec/decision-records/0001 Decision 4 ratifies. Produced by issue #132; see that record's candidates/README.md. DEFINITIONS -- `<fall|rise>_floor_ns_<corner>`: the smallest value in any cell_fall (resp. cell_rise) table of ANY timing arc of the cell; the delay no path can beat through this cell on that transition direction at that corner, whichever input pin switches and regardless of output load or input slew. `<...>_worst_arc_floor_ns_<corner>`: the same quantity maximised over arcs (the SLOWEST input pin's floor on that edge). `<...>_derate_x`: floor_ns at ss_n40C_1v28 divided by floor_ns at tt_025C_1v80. WHY POLARITY IS SEPARATED: in this library it is the dominant axis -- several non-inverting compound cells are ordinary on one edge and pathological on the other (sky130_fd_sc_hd__or4_1 falls in >= 4.4591 ns at ss_n40C_1v28 but rises in 0.2394 ns), and a path picks up whichever edge it actually propagates. A polarity-blind reduction hides exactly the effect that binds. `excluded_in_rows_2_5_6` is the criterion the 209-cell abc -dont_use list in yosys-cell-exclusion.ys was built from: worst_arc_any_polarity_floor_ns_ss_n40C_1v28 > 1.0 -- i.e. this cell has at least one input pin that, on at least one edge, cannot switch in less than 10% of the 10.0 ns clock period, before any load. Sequential cells (ff/latch) are excluded from the table entirely. Extracted from the installed sky130A liberty, open_pdks c6d73a35f524070e85faff4a6a9eef49553ebc2b.
